author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
I've been following Trench Crusade's epic journey on my channel since their very first kickstarter and NOW just two short years later they've JUST released their very first massive narrative campaign boxset called Carcass Front!! 

If you're Trench Crusade Curious OR if you're planning on picking up the box yourself then this is the PERFECT video for you!

BUT if you also want to see me push myself and my painting abilities to the next level as i attempt to do one of my best paintjobs ever on the beautiful new Stigmatic Nun mini from the set then stay tuned as well... because in this video we are doing it all! 

JOIN US ON DISCORD AND PATREON HERE!!
https://www.patreon.com/roguehobbies
